claims.claim: Intellia reported positive Phase 3 HAELO data for lonvo-z, anticipated FDA BLA acceptance in the second half of 2026 and a U.S. launch in the first half of 2027, representing a near-term test of in-vivo CRISPR commercialization.

risks.risk: Regulatory acceptance, approval, launch execution and long-term safety remain binary-to-high-impact uncertainties for a first-wave in-vivo gene-editing product.

unknowns.unknown: Commercial uptake, pricing, payer access and long-duration safety remain unproven before launch.

claims.claim: Intellia ended Q2 with about $628 million of cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities and expected that capital to fund operations at least into 2028; nex-z Phase 3 enrollment had also restarted.
On September 4 Intellia added a senior secured term-loan facility of up to $400 million, with $75 million funded upfront and additional tranches tied to milestones.

risks.risk: Debt extends flexibility but introduces secured financing obligations and milestone dependence; runway guidance remains management expectation.

unknowns.unknown: Exact future draw timing, covenant headroom and commercialization cash needs require financial underwriting.
